property.name: ranger.plugin.pinot.service.name
property.description: Name of the Ranger service containing policies for this Pinot instance

property.name: ranger.plugin.pinot.policy.source.impl
property.description: Class to retrieve policies from the source

property.name: ranger.plugin.pinot.policy.rest.ssl.config.file
property.description: Path to the file containing SSL details to contact Ranger Admin

property.name: ranger.plugin.pinot.policy.cache.dir
property.description: Directory where the policies downloaded from Ranger Admin are cached, so that a Pinot component starting while Ranger Admin is down enforces the last known policies (without a cache it denies every request).

property.name: ranger.plugin.pinot.policy.pollIntervalMs
property.description: How often to poll for changes in policies?

property.name: ranger.plugin.pinot.policy.rest.client.connection.timeoutMs
property.description: S3 Plugin RangerRestClient Connection Timeout in Milli Seconds

property.name: ranger.plugin.pinot.policy.rest.client.read.timeoutMs
property.description: S3 Plugin RangerRestClient read Timeout in Milli Seconds

property.name: ranger.plugin.pinot.decision.cache.ttl.ms
property.description: How long a decision is reused for the same user, groups, resource and access type (0 disables). Reused decisions are not audited again.

property.name: ranger.plugin.pinot.ugi.initialize
property.description: Kerberos clusters: true, so that the plug-in logs in from the keytab below and downloads policies with SPNEGO (Ranger Admin refuses unauthenticated downloads). Set by Ambari when Kerberos is enabled.

property.name: ranger.plugin.pinot.ugi.keytab.principal
property.description: Pinot's Kerberos principal; its short name must be in the service's policy.download.auth.users.
